name: Signature Holo

components.pose: She hovers a hand's breadth above the ground, the scythe raised overhead in both hands as a great arc of soul-light sweeps from the blade, her cape billowing upward, chin lifted, a regal, commanding gaze straight to the camera; full figure visible.
components.effects: A spiral of {{MAGIC}} soul-energy coils up the scythe, a vast host of spectral shades rises from the necropolis behind her, ravens burst from her cape, violet lightning forks across the sky and a ring of glowing sigils halos behind her head.
components.companion: her aligned Elder Dragon, Umbrath, rearing up enormous behind her with its wings spread across the sky, obsidian-black and midnight-violet scales, wings like tattered sheets of darkness edged in amethyst light, amethyst fire pouring from its jaws

notes: HOLO edition 'Reaper Queen': the Signature scene re-authored with an ascended pose, upgraded signature weapon, crown, mantle, grander magic and a closer dragon. Holo shader/foil is applied in the client, not baked in.
